name: outrunner 63100 14p - SHAPE, not measured
note: Not a measurement. A SHAPE for the identifier to recover: numbers of the order a large 63 mm, 100 mm stack outrunner has, so autodetect is exercised against more than one machine and a step that only works on the placeholder is caught. `tools/bench/commission.py` and `observer.autodetect` write a real motor over the record; a profile is how one is kept and put back. `drive` keys are coaxial.devices.drive.PARAMS names, SI, `model` keys coaxial.devices.drive.MODEL_PARAMS names.
